name: Animate UI
description: An animated component distribution built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Motion-powered wrappers for Radix, Base UI and Headless UI, plus a library of animated buttons, backgrounds and primitives — installed through the shadcn CLI and MIT-licensed.
